name: NG Starter Portraits
description: Text-first starter portrait choices for the character creator. These are portrait IDs and descriptions, not final painted portrait assets yet.

portraits.name: Weathered Drifter
portraits.summary: A road-worn traveler with a rain-dark cloak, tired eyes, and the look of someone who counts exits before greetings.

portraits.name: Disgraced Squire
portraits.summary: A young fighter with battered manners, an old bruise near the jaw, and a cloak pin from a house that no longer claims them.

portraits.name: Village Outcast
portraits.summary: A sharp-eyed local with uneven-cut hair, wary posture, and the stubborn expression of someone used to being blamed first.

portraits.name: Caravan Guard
portraits.summary: A practical guard with weathered leather, a hood against road rain, and eyes trained to search treelines and crowd edges.
